ItemID: NA; Title: Come On Get Happy! The Very Best Of The Partridge Family; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Light pop does not fit the blues and roots rock I want right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Driving Towards The Daylight; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent interest in Old Sock and People, Hell & Angels; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: Abbey Road; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Classic rock appeals to me, but I am more interested in blues guitar this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Night Castle; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The theatrical symphonic rock sound is outside my current listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its guitar-driven rock feels like a promising follow-up to You Should Be So Lucky; I would try it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy songwriting appeals to my country and blues interests, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Dust Bowl; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues rock fits my taste, but one blues selection is enough for this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Here We Stand; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not give me enough reason to expect a match, so I would pass.
ItemID: NA; Title: ON AIR Deluxe; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I cannot confidently identify this release from the title, so it does not draw me in.
ItemID: NA; Title: Get Yer Ya-Ya's Out!; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Live blues-influenced rock suits me, but I would stick with my two choices this time.
